fields.label: Holding location for stock moving between outlets
fields.description: Needed only when stock may move between outlets. Stock stays in this location while it is on the way.

fields.label: How automatic stock work is handled
fields.description: Review First saves suggestions for approval. Active allows only the actions and limits below. Paused stops new automatic stock work.

fields.label: Checked opening stock count
fields.description: The approved starting amount for every ingredient and supply.

fields.label: Oldest stock information JiJi may use (minutes)
Preferred tablet for preparation tasks
fields.description: Optional. If this tablet is not up to date, JiJi sends the task to another outlet tablet that a manager can use.

fields.label: Largest allowed difference in amount made or wasted (%)
fields.description: Optional limit approved by a director. If the difference is larger, the preparation needs review. JiJi uses this only when the ingredient recipe has no limit.

fields.label: Actions JiJi may prepare automatically
fields.description: Choose only the stock actions this outlet has approved. Automatic supplier orders always remain drafts and are never sent.

fields.label: Exact Quantity Ceiling (Decimal)
fields.description: Canonical decimal text for this automation ceiling. Frappe's Float/Currency copy is display only; planning compares against this value. Historical rows may leave this blank.

fields.label: Largest total value JiJi may suggest
Exact Value Ceiling (Decimal)
fields.description: Canonical decimal text for this automation ceiling. Frappe's Float/Currency copy is display only; planning compares against this value. Historical rows may leave this blank.

fields.label: Largest allowed count difference (%)
fields.description: Optional limit approved by a director. A larger difference must be reviewed before a stock correction draft is created.

fields.label: Exact Count Variance Percent Ceiling (Decimal)
fields.description: Canonical decimal text for this automation ceiling. Frappe's Float/Currency copy is display only; planning compares against this value. Historical rows may leave this blank.

fields.label: Exact Count Variance Value Ceiling (Decimal)
fields.description: Canonical decimal text for this automation ceiling. Frappe's Float/Currency copy is display only; planning compares against this value. Historical rows may leave this blank.

fields.label: Account used for ingredient cost
fields.description: Accounting account used when ingredients and supplies are consumed or written off.

fields.label: COGS Account (deprecated)
fields.description: Deprecated. Use Expense / COGS Account. Retained read-only so an existing value stays visible after migration; nothing reads this field.

fields.label: System user for automatic stock work
fields.description: Dedicated restricted user that may create internal restock requests (Material Requests) and supplier order drafts (Draft Purchase Orders). JiJi never sends or submits a supplier order.

fields.label: Director responsible for stock problems
fields.description: Enabled Company Director who receives tasks when this outlet has a stock problem. Choose someone explicitly; JiJi never assigns these tasks to Administrator.

fields.label: Director who reviews supplier order drafts
fields.description: Company Director who checks supplier order drafts created by JiJi. The draft is never sent or submitted automatically.
